alt: Hematopoietic stem cell differentiation: an unbiased HSC in the bone marrow giving rise to balanced and differentiation-biased HSCs (osteoid-, myeloid-, platelet- and lymphoid-biased), which in turn produce osteoclasts, megakaryocytes and platelets, monocytes, macrophages, dendritic cells, neutrophils, eosinophils, basophils, erythrocytes, and T, NK, B and plasma cells.
